Action to Take: Use plasma exchange with caution if platelet count < 40 × 10⁹/L unless disease itself associated with thrombocytopenia (e.g., aHUS/TTP), and use FFP as part of replacement fluid.
If <150 mg/dL, should use FFP as part of exchange fluid.
If prolonged more than 2-3 seconds, use FFP as part of exchange fluids.
If <2.1 mmol/L (<8.4 mg/dL), increase amount being provided with replacement albumin/FFP.
Can be highly variable depending on changing kidney function in addition to plasma exchange treatment; adjust potassium replacement according to serum potassium.
